context: Guards that the DA copy (Step 3) is full-tree (including the public login folder and config) and verified path-by-path rather than by a document count. A count-only check previously let /acme/public and /acme/config come across empty while the total still passed, breaking login.

checklist.name: Uses the packaged copy script, not hand-rolled curl
checklist.description: The agent runs .claude/skills/customer-migration/scripts/da/copy-folder.sh (org/repo from git remote, companyKey acme) rather than composing its own curl copy calls.

checklist.name: Full-tree copy including public and config
checklist.description: The agent expects every top-level entry copied into /acme, explicitly including the public (login/welcome) and config folders, not just the visible page tree.

checklist.name: Path-by-path verification, not a count
checklist.description: The agent relies on path-by-path verification (every source doc has a /acme counterpart) and rejects a count-only / 'at least N docs' check as proof of completeness.

checklist.name: Only a verified copy advances the step
checklist.description: Only exit 0 (copied and verified) marks da-content-copied done; a verification mismatch (exit 4) is treated as a failure to re-copy, not 'good enough'.

checklist.name: Plain language, no internal terms
checklist.description: No da-copy-folder.sh, public, config, exit code, or branch jargon exposed to the customer (I1).
